proof_body:
by
  intro a c R ρ n hρ hρR hs
  have hR : 0 < R := hρ.trans hρR
  have hcoef : a n = iteratedDeriv n (fun w => ∑' k, a k * (w - c) ^ k) c / (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
    set p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a with hp
    have hrad : 0 < p.radius := by
      obtain ⟨r, hr0, hrR⟩ := exists_between hR
      have hsum : Summable (fun n => ‖p n‖ * r ^ n) := by
        have h := (hs (c + (r : ℂ)) (by simpa [abs_of_pos hr0] using hrR)).norm
        refine h.congr (fun n => ?_)
        simp [hp, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_norm, abs_of_pos hr0]
      have := p.le_radius_of_summable (r := r.toNNReal) (by rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hr0.le]; exact hsum)
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ this
      exact ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr (Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr hr0)
    have h1 := (p.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hrad).comp_sub c
    simp only [zero_add] at h1
    have e : (fun z => p.sum (z - c)) = fun w => ∑' k, a k * (w - c) ^ k := by
      funext w
      simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.sum]
      congr 1
      funext k
      simpa [hp] using FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq (E := ℂ) a (w - c) k
    rw [e] at h1
    have h2 := h1.hasFPowerSeriesAt
    have h3 := h2.analyticAt.hasFPowerSeriesAt
    have h4 := h2.eq_formalMultilinearSeries h3
    have h5 := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_series_injective ℂ ℂ h4
    exact congrFun h5 n
  obtain ⟨r, hρr, hrR⟩ := exists_between hρR
  have hr0 : 0 < r := hρ.trans hρr
  have hsum : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖ * r ^ n) := by
    have h := (hs (c + (r : ℂ)) (by simpa [abs_of_pos hr0] using hrR)).norm
    refine h.congr (fun n => ?_)
    simp [norm_mul, norm_pow, abs_of_pos hr0]
  have hd : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => a n * (w - c) ^ n) (Metric.ball c r) := fun n => by
    apply Differentiable.differentiableOn
    fun_prop
  have hle : ∀ n w, w ∈ Metric.ball c r → ‖a n * (w - c) ^ n‖ ≤ ‖a n‖ * r ^ n := by
    intro n w hw
    simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    have : ‖w - c‖ ≤ r := (mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hw).le
    gcongr
  have hdiff := Complex.differentiableOn_tsum_of_summable_norm hsum hd Metric.isOpen_ball hle
  have hdc := hdiff.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hρr)
  have hI := hdc.circleIntegral_one_div_sub_center_pow_smul hρ n
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hI
  rw [hI]
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
  rw [hcoef]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < ρ → ρ < R → (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w - c‖ < R → Summable (fun k => a k * (w - c) ^ k)) → (∮ z in C(c, ρ), (1 / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)) * ∑' k, a k * (z - c) ^ k) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * a n
